scope: Phase 2B staging only; no production activation

findings.evidence: Official broadcaster operates current free web/app programming, but no independently validated embeddable HLS/DASH source was established for Hidden Tunes.
FIFA+ currently offers real live events, but equivalence to the discontinued Pluto linear channel and an in-app-safe direct source are not established.
CNN confirms CNN International live streaming requires CNN subscription or a qualifying TV provider; it is not a lawful anonymous replacement source.
Public listing confirms lawful distribution, but an external player page alone does not satisfy Hidden Tunes playback requirements.

openSourceLifecycleEvidence.finding: Current implementation relies on authenticated, persistent per-tuner Pluto sessions and periodic guide refresh; not reusable under the no-account/no-session-copy Phase 2B constraints.
A 2025 rewrite indicates continuing catalog/lifecycle churn, but it does not by itself prove lawful reusable playback for Hidden Tunes.
A 2026 removal request is recent evidence that cached Pluto playlist entries require active provenance and lifecycle revalidation.
